detail.headline: 2025 Portland Book Festival Audiobook
detail.excerpt: Literary Arts is excited to announce that we have partnered with Libro.FM to bring you an exclusive audiobook showcasing some of the most popular 2025 Portland Book Festival author sessions. You’ll hear from authors like Stacey Abrams, Kristen Arnett, Omar El Akkad, Tara Roberts, Karen Russell, and more! This audiobook is free; all you need to do is create a Libro.FM account to enjoy. 2025 Portlan
